name: cabrasgo
description: CabrasGo — ride-sharing/mobility platform for Las Cabras, Peumo, San Vicente and the Lago Rapel basin (VI Región, Chile).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:push && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
